question: What holds the heavenly regions together at the level of Dhruva?
premises: At this level all things are understood to be bound within the sphere of wind.
The seven heavenly wind-masses are present there.
These wind-masses begin chiefly with the cloud-bearing layer.
inference: The upper heavenly structure is supported and organized by seven principal strata of wind.
uncertainties: The names of all seven wind-masses are not listed in this verse.
plain_english: Here all things are to be understood as bound within the sphere of wind. The seven heavenly wind-masses are there, beginning chiefly with the cloud-bearing layer.
